description: Batch record for the Opus development second calls, D1b-o. Eleven rows, the rows the committed corrective pass fires on. The answers are in dev.second_call.opus48.jsonl, one JSON object per line keyed and sorted by custom_id, each carrying the response whole.

population.source: the rows src.complete.augment.augment fires on, 11 of 12
population.excluded: dev_07, on which the reference grammar extracts nothing so nothing can be absent

decoding.meaning: temperature null means the parameter is omitted, because the tier rejects a non-default value as gate 1a measured. thinking is set to adaptive and effort to low, both explicitly, because the pre-registration fixes reasoning effort low on this tier and the tier's default thinking is off, so effort alone would describe nothing.

usage_totals.note: Summed from the usage block of every record. The input total equals the count_tokens figure re-derived over the same eleven bodies before submission, 69906, exactly. Thinking is reported above zero on this tier: output_tokens_details is present and not null on all eleven records, and 4 of them carry a thinking_tokens above zero, summing to 335. The per-row figures are in usage_per_row below. The other two tiers differ from this one and from each other on the same condition: on sonnet5 the field is present and not null on all eleven with a thinking_tokens of 0, and on haiku45 output_tokens_details is absent on all eleven, so that tier reports no thinking figure at all rather than a zero.

cost_usd.rates: batch input $2.50 / MTok, batch output $12.50 / MTok, eval/generation_predictions.md line 1087
